text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I think I'd like to increase the<n>number of
laps.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I should consult my trainer about it as<n>soon as I
can. I wonder if they'll still<n>be in their office...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Good idea. And don't forget to ask<n>for a rod and
tackle for our fishing trip<n>while you're at it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Sei. I don't recall<n>agreeing to any such
excursion.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You didn't? Well, that's a drag.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I was just kinda thinking<n>you've
changed, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? In what way? I don't feel any<n>different...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aw, c'mon. You of all people, looking<n>for a trainer's
advice? I almost didn't<n>believe my ears!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My little Grass is finally learning torely on others. Sniff, sniff... You'vemade your mother so proud.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Oh, cut it out. Since when did<n>you become
my mother?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, what a life-changing revelation!<n>I'll have to
start calling you "Mom"<n>from now on. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And I simply must introduce you to<n>my class and
dormmates. Surely<n>they'd love to meet my long-lost
mother.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ha... hahaha... I, uh, maybe I'll get a<n>few more laps
in first.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Silly Sei... Though she might be<n>right that I've
changed.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness... Now I'm getting all<n>flustered and
self-conscious. How am<n>I to consult my trainer in
this state?
